node.title: XR deficient-window primitive Pade-pencil normal form
node.statement: On every official high-band depth, if the deficient maximal selected family is nonempty, then r'=n-k-d>2d-2 forces every two left syzygies to have zero polynomial determinant. Hence the complete kernel is {(SP,SQ):S in W} for one coprime nonproportional primitive pair P,Q. If ell=max(deg P,deg Q) and G is the forced common H-root set, then ell>=1, ell+|G|<=d-1, dim K<=d-ell-|G|, the primitive error relation P(u-f)+Q(v-g)=0 holds off G, and every counted codeword pair lies uniquely in one affine family (f0+Q tau,g0-P tau), deg tau<k-ell. Distinct pair cores intersect in at most k-ell-1 points. The residual |G|>=2(h-d) can occur only for d>=ceil((2h+2)/3), with ell<=3d-2h-1. No occupancy count or locator-pencil payment is asserted.
